# skill-finder Plugin

Analyze projects and find relevant AI skills. Install via npx add-skill from GitHub and skills.sh.

## Commands

- `/skill-finder:search` - Analyze project and search for relevant skills

## File Structure

```
skill-finder/
├── .claude-plugin/plugin.json  # Plugin metadata
├── skills/skill-finder/        # AI agent skill
│   └── SKILL.md               # Search skill instructions
└── CLAUDE.md                  # This file
```
